item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers limited preview support for AI model management, letting users provision fully managed models directly in the database. The preview covers embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Embedding generation in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now offers public preview of built-in embedding generation. The feature converts content into vector embeddings using Azure Data-developed models to support semantic search and retrieval.

  • Source: Azure Updates
